subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read about the history of frankincense in Oman.
Explain why Al Balid and Khawr Ruri were important ports.
Write about an ancient place in Oman using set phrases.

tf.s: Many frankincense trees grow in Wadi Dawkah in the south of Oman.
tf.why: Wadi Dawkah is in the south of Oman.

tf.s: In the past, people used frankincense for perfume and medicine.
tf.why: Frankincense was used for perfume and medicine.

tf.s: Al Balid and Khawr Ruri were important mountains.
tf.why: Al Balid and Khawr Ruri were important ports.

tf.s: Boats took frankincense from the ports to markets in other countries.
tf.why: That is why the ports were important.

tf.s: People built big walls and forts at the ports to guard them.
tf.why: Frankincense was very important, so they guarded the ports.

tf.s: The Museum of Frankincense Land is in Wadi Dawkah.
tf.why: The Museum of Frankincense Land is at Al Balid.

tf.s: The buildings at Bat are about 50 years old.
tf.why: The buildings at Bat are about 5,000 years old.

tf.s: When you present, you should look at the people you are talking to.
tf.why: Looking at your audience is a good speaking tip.

boxes.q: Where do many frankincense trees grow?
boxes.why: Many trees grow in Wadi Dawkah.

boxes.q: What did people use frankincense for in the past?
boxes.why: Frankincense was used for perfume and medicine.
Boats come and go from a port.

boxes.q: What is the name of the museum at Al Balid?
boxes.why: It is called the Museum of Frankincense Land.

boxes.q: Complete: This place is ______ Bahla Fort.
How old are the buildings at Bat?
Why did people build forts at the ports?
boxes.why: Forts helped guard the important ports.

boxes.q: Which phrase tells the age of a place?

mcq.why: Wadi Dawkah is in the south of Oman.

mcq.q: Which two places were important frankincense ports?
mcq.why: Al Balid and Khawr Ruri were ports.

mcq.q: Which word means "to keep something safe from danger"?
mcq.why: People guarded the ports with walls and forts.

mcq.q: Which speaking tip is in this lesson?
o: Look at the people you are talking to.
mcq.why: Looking at the audience helps them listen.

mcq.q: Choose a good sentence for your page about an ancient place.
o: Today, you can see old towers and ruins.
Today, you can see old towers and ruins tomorrow.
Today, you can sees old towers.
mcq.why: Today, you can see … is a set phrase.

mcq.q: You are writing about Bat. Which sentence is correct?
Why did Al Balid and Khawr Ruri become important ports?
o: Boats took frankincense from them to markets in other countries.
mcq.why: Trading frankincense made the ports important.

mcq.q: Why did people build big walls and forts at the ports?
o: Frankincense was very important, so they guarded the ports.
They wanted to grow trees there.
They wanted to stop boats coming.

mcq.q: Which is the best order for a page about an ancient place?
o: This place is called … It is in … It is about … years old. Today, you can see …
Today, you can see … This place is called …
It is about … years old. Hi, I'm …
mcq.why: First the name, then where it is, its age and what you can see today.
